paragraphs: R. Chanina ben Agol, end of Shor SheNagach Et HaParah, 54b: he asked R. Chiyya bar Abba why the first tablets did not say “that it may be well.” Chiyya directed him to R. Tanchum bar Chanilai, and he went to him (55a). Jerusalem Talmud, end of HaBa Al Yevimto: R. Chanina bar Agol, in R. Chizkiyah's name.
